changelog:
New Features:
• Dynamic Model Fetching: Added a Fetch Available Models button in settings that queries Google and Groq APIs to dynamically load the exact models you have access to.
• Chat Streaming & Real-time Speech: Chat dialog now streams responses in real-time, buffering chunks and speaking them sentence-by-sentence to eliminate long loading pauses.
• Custom Personas: Added a System Prompt field in settings to customize the AI's personality and instructions.
• Audio Earcons: Added NVDA beeps to indicate translation status (a rising beep for thinking, a pleasant chord for success, and a flat beep for errors).
Improvements & Enhancements:
• Enter to Send: You can now press Enter to instantly send messages in the Chat Dialog, and Shift+Enter to insert a new line.
• Accessible Update Dialog: Completely redesigned the update notification popup to be screen-reader friendly, placing the changelog inside a navigable read-only text box with accessible Yes/No buttons.
• Localization Support: Wrapped all hardcoded error messages and UI strings in translation markers so the add-on can be easily translated into other languages.
Bug Fixes:
• Thread Safety: Moved clipboard reading and API requests to background threads to prevent the entire NVDA interface from freezing during heavy processing.
• Error Handling: Refactored API wrappers to raise proper exceptions instead of returning silent error strings, ensuring you are audibly notified when things fail.
